notes: Version 1.2 types the fibre winding and states the missing link to charge. The winding in pi_1(S^1) = Z is invariant for configurations in a fixed fibre or over a trivialising domain of the base, not for configurations in the whole fibre S^3, where every loop is contractible; a chosen domain therefore enters the winding result as well as pi_2 = 0. The identification of the winding with electric charge in the emergent description is not derived, since no relation between the internal fibre and an emergent electromagnetic potential is supplied, and charge quantisation there is open. The Hopf bundle is the bundle of the unit Dirac monopole over the internal base, and it is this unit class that makes every fibre winding contractible in the whole fibre, so the former statement that the two mechanisms are logically independent is withdrawn. The title is changed accordingly. pi_2 = 0 on the chosen domain is kept, and the absence of magnetic monopoles remains open.
